sky cinema premiere.title: Hungry
sky cinema premiere.desc: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose.

sky cinema action.title: Love Hurts
sky cinema action.desc: Marvin is a Milwaukee realtor who receives a crimson envelope from a former partner-in-crime whom he left for dead. He now finds himself thrust back into a world of ruthless hit men and double-crosses that turn his open houses into deadly war zones.

sky cinema action.title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
sky cinema action.desc: A Hong Kong detective is contracted to recover a stolen nuclear warhead. Hired by both the CIA and Russian intelligence, the kung-fu cop is harassed, assaulted and framed for murder as he delves into the murky world of international arms dealing.

sky cinema action.title: Clash of the Titans
sky cinema action.desc: Perseus travels the underworld to defeat the evil god Hades, who seeks to overthrow Zeus and bring hell to Earth.

sky cinema action.title: Safe
sky cinema action.desc: A cage fighter protects a 12-year-old math prodigy from mobsters and corrupt cops, who are all prepared to kill for the priceless numerical code she carries in her head.

sky cinema action.title: Olympus Has Fallen
sky cinema action.desc: America's national security team must rely on a disgraced former guard to save the president after terrorists seize control of the White House, taking the chief of state hostage.

sky cinema family.title: The Addams Family
sky cinema family.desc: The lives of Gomez and Morticia Addams are thrown into disarray when a scheming siren attempts to pass off her son as Gomez's long-lost brother Fester. Once installed in the family's spooky mansion, mother and son set their minds on stealing the family fortune.

sky cinema family.title: Addams Family Values
sky cinema family.desc: With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.

sky cinema family.title: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
sky cinema family.desc: When Tom and Jerry are transported through time to a distant era, they must work together to find a way back home.

sky cinema family.title: Flushed Away
sky cinema family.desc: A spoiled rat gets flushed down the toilet and finds himself stranded in London's sewer underworld. A savvy scavenger helps him evade frog assassins and make his way back to his plush home.

sky cinema family.title: Casper
sky cinema family.desc: Stylish, visual effects-laden family fare about a lonely boy-ghost who befriends the young daughter of a ghost hunter. A grasping heiress calls in the exorcist to clear out the spooks and gain access to the treasures supposedly hidden in the lonely mansion. Father and daughter discover that Casper is not the only spirit haunting the house and find themselves caught up in a fantastic adventure.

sky cinema comedy.title: Panda Plan
sky cinema comedy.desc: An action movie star must protect baby pandas from a group of mercenaries.

sky cinema comedy.title: Panda Plan 2: The Magical Tribe
sky cinema comedy.desc: Jackie Chan and panda Hu Hu stumble upon a hidden jungle society that hails the panda as a "divine beast." Jackie must face a group of tribal warriors to protect his panda friend and uncover the ancient secrets of the mysterious land.

sky cinema comedy.title: Zoolander
sky cinema comedy.desc: A disgraced male model becomes the unwitting fall guy in an evil designer's plot to assassinate a world leader.

sky cinema comedy.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
sky cinema comedy.desc: Knockabout comedy set in the sexist world of 1970s newscasting. Ron Burgundy, San Diego's top-rated anchorman, reigns supreme in the all-male world of television news, until the arrival of an ambitious female reporter upsets the status quo. When she steps in to present the programme in Ron's absence, an uncivil war breaks out in the newsroom.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Men in Black 3
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Agent J goes back to the swinging 60s in a time-travelling mission to save his partner from a murderous alien.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Flatliners
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Led by fame-hungry Nelson, a group of medical students embark on a daring experiment: to take a peek into the afterlife by taking turns to be clinically `killed' and then resuscitated. Unfortunately, the experiment goes horribly wrong.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Flatliners
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Five medical students create near-death experiences, in order to understand the age-old question of what lies beyond the confines of life. As their experiments become increasingly perilous, each one is forced to face the consequences.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Evolution
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A science professor and his cohorts battle a slew of rapidly growing alien organisms that threaten to overrun the Earth.

sky cinema thriller.title: Mulholland Drive
sky cinema thriller.desc: An actress bonds with an amnesiac in director David Lynch's surreal Hollywood tale.

sky cinema thriller.title: Caddo Lake
sky cinema thriller.desc: When an 8-year-old girl mysteriously vanishes, a series of past deaths and disappearances start to link together, forever altering a broken family's history.

sky cinema thriller.title: Hotel Mumbai
sky cinema thriller.desc: Terror strikes in the heart of Mumbai, India, as members of Lashkar-e-Taiba storm the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel in a series of coordinated attacks throughout the city. Amid the gunfire and mayhem, a brave chef and kitchen worker decide to risk their own lives to try and protect the frightened guests. As the militants continue their assault on the hotel, a desperate couple must do whatever they can to protect their newborn baby.

sky cinema thriller.title: Extremely Wicked, Shockingly Evil and Vile
sky cinema thriller.desc: A chronicle of the crimes of Ted Bundy, from the perspective of his longtime girlfriend, who refused to believe the truth about him for years.

sky cinema greats.title: Dog Day Afternoon
sky cinema greats.desc: A desperate and crazed man, with the help of an accomplice, takes a local Brooklyn bank hostage with plans to rob it in order to pay for his lover's sex-change operation.

sky cinema greats.title: Jaws
sky cinema greats.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

sky cinema greats.title: Jaws 2
sky cinema greats.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

sky cinema greats.title: Jaws III
sky cinema greats.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

sky cinema greats.title: The Hunt for Red October
sky cinema greats.desc: Soviet and American forces give chase when the captain of a Soviet nuclear submarine sets a course for the Maine coast.

sky cinema drama.title: Moneyball
sky cinema drama.desc: Faced with a tight budget, a baseball manager and his partner recruit bargain bin players that scouts have labelled as flawed, but have game-winning potential.

sky cinema drama.title: Jerry Maguire
sky cinema drama.desc: A sports agent who makes the mistake of saying what he believes, finds himself sacked and abandoned by all his clients apart from small time footballer Rod Tidwell. Maguire's personal life starts to fall apart as he's torn between love and money in Cameron Crowe's metaphor on Americans' need for success and money.

sky cinema drama.title: Cool Hand Luke
sky cinema drama.desc: A gutsy prisoner earns the admiration of inmates and the wrath of guards by constant defiance and bids for freedom.

sky cinema drama.title: Valentine's Day
sky cinema drama.desc: Following a group of Los Angeles' residents who try to find their way through the highs and lows of love during a single day.
